title: Do SpeechLMs Hear Their Own Opinions? Diagnosing and Mitigating Previous-Belief Contamination in Streaming Emotion Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.20769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming emotion understanding uses historical state while continuously interpreting current audio, often feeding the model's previous prediction back as context. We show that this history conditioning can distort current perception. On a balanced CREMA-D-Stream counterfactual diagnostic, changing only the injected previous emotion label while holding the audio fixed reduces current-audio accuracy from 72.50% to 30.42% and flips 65.69% of predictions. translated_title: 语音语言模型会听到自己的观点吗？流式情绪理解中先前信念污染的诊断与缓解
translated_abstract: 流式情绪理解在持续解读当前音频时使用历史状态，通常会将模型的先前预测作为上下文反馈。我们表明，这种历史条件化可能扭曲当前感知。在平衡的CREMA-D-Stream反事实诊断中，仅改变注入的先前情绪标签而保持音频固定，当前音频准确率从72.50%降至30.42%，且65.69%的预测发生翻转。该效应强烈呈现标签不对称性，先验拉动范围从4.76%到98.20%，揭示了我们称之为“先前信念污染”（PBC）的失败模式。为解决PBC，我们引入了EmoUpdate，一种无需训练的框架，通过三个组件将当前音频感知与历史状态修订分离：（1）先验盲声学防火墙，防止历史状态进入感知；（2）证据缩减的因果信念过滤器，仅在观察后引入历史信息。
tldr: 本文发现流式情绪理解中历史状态反馈会导致“先前信念污染”，扭曲当前音频感知，并提出无需训练的EmoUpdate框架，通过分离感知与历史修订来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "previous-belief contamination" in streaming emotion understanding, where historical feedback distorts current audio perception, and proposes EmoUpdate, a training-free framework that separates perception from historical revision to mitigate it.
